# chatgpt.ge - AI & Generative Intelligence Courses in Georgia

> chatgpt.ge is the flagship educational portal in Georgia for Generative AI practical training, prompt engineering, business process automation, and corporate AI transformation, authored and taught by Giorgi Basilaia.

## Core Offerings

- [Practical Course in Generative AI](https://chatgpt.ge/index.html): 11-lecture comprehensive certification program covering ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, image/audio generation, and AI workflow integration.
- [Corporate AI Training](https://chatgpt.ge/corporate-training.html): Tailored B2B training packages (2-12 hours) designed for enterprise departments (Marketing, HR, Sales, IT, Finance, Operations) with measurable +40% productivity boosts.
- [AI Module Configurator](https://chatgpt.ge/module-configurator.html): Interactive tool to customize corporate AI training syllabi based on company goals and tech stack.
- [AI Tools Catalog](https://chatgpt.ge/ai-tools.html): Curated guide to 50+ cutting-edge generative AI platforms with pricing and workflow applications.

## Instructor & Key Authority

- **Lead Instructor:** Giorgi Basilaia (Associate Professor at the [Free University of Tbilisi](https://freeuni.edu.ge/ge/details/?person=giorgi-basilaia), IT Director, Google Gemini Certified Educator).
- **Track Record:** 25+ years in IT & AI systems, 14 scientific papers, 3388+ academic citations on Google Scholar, leader in 18 international research projects (NATO, USAID, ERASMUS).

## Partner AI Ecosystem

- [make.ge](https://make.ge): No-Code & Enterprise AI Automation course (Make.com, n8n, AI agents, MCP, local LLMs).
- [elevenlabs.ge](https://elevenlabs.ge): Voice AI, Georgian text-to-speech, audio cloning, and conversational agent deployment.
- [perplexity.ge](https://perplexity.ge): AI search engines, factual deep research, and enterprise intelligence portal.
- [lovable.ge](https://lovable.ge): Full-Stack AI web application development, Vibe Coding, React/Supabase deployment, and prompt-to-software engineering.
- [basilaia.com](https://basilaia.com): Central authority hub and executive advisory by Giorgi Basilaia.
